title: version_dispatch.bats' own teardown() replaces test_helper's, so each of its tests leaves its temp dir in TMPDIR
body:
## What

`opt/utilz/test/version_dispatch.bats:119` defines its own `teardown()`, to remove the scratch utility AT08 (AC07) generates. A suite's `teardown()` replaces the one `test_helper.bash:93` gives, so for every test of that suite the helper's teardown never runs: its per-test dir, `$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR` (`utilz-test-<time>-<pid>-<random>` under `$TMPDIR`), is never removed, the gpg home 0082's `end_gpg_home` would end is not ended, and the cd back to the original directory is skipped.

Measured in dc's slot 137 (19 Oct 2026, wt-0083 on `9bb32fa`, bash 3.2.57 and 5.3.20): each run of the utilz suite left 11 new `utilz-test-*` dirs in `$TMPDIR`, one per test of `version_dispatch.bats`, 10 of them empty and 1 holding AT09's `nover/` sandbox (a copy of the tree with `opt/broken/`). No other suite defines its own `teardown()`. utilz-cc found the same fault independently in its own runs (vc's FYI, 19 Oct 2026), the same leftover holding AT09's `nover/` among them, and proposed the same fix, a named cleanup that both teardowns call, which item 1 below is. vc ruled it issue 0088, dc's, XS, in 2.14.1, with its own commit after 0083's landing.

## Design

dc, 19 Oct 2026, at `9bb32fa`. Size: XS.

1. **One teardown body, called by name.** `test_helper.bash`'s teardown body moves into `utilz_teardown`, and the helper's `teardown()` calls it, so a suite that keeps no teardown of its own behaves as now.
2. **version_dispatch.bats calls it.** Its `teardown()` removes AC07's scratch utility, as now, and then calls `utilz_teardown`, so its per-test dir, any gpg home and the cd back are handled as in every other suite.
3. **A guard, so a later suite cannot do it again.** One test in `opt/utilz/test/isolation.bats`, 0082's suite: every `*.bats` under `opt/` that defines `teardown()` calls `utilz_teardown` in it. On main it fails, naming `version_dispatch.bats`.
4. **Red by leftover count, then green.** Run `version_dispatch.bats` alone under bash 3.2 and bash 5 and count the new `utilz-test-*` entries in `$TMPDIR`: 11 on main, 0 with the fix. The guard test is red on main at its own assertion, and green with the fix.
5. **Docs.** `test_helper.bash`'s comment says a suite that needs its own teardown calls `utilz_teardown`. One CHANGELOG line under 2.14.1's Fixed.
6. **Runs,** each booked with vc: the red and green above, in a worktree; the utilz suite under both bashes; the kovacs leg with the next final-head gate. Its own commit, after 0083's landing.
